_doc: Rules of the C extractor (keys: see ts_generic.rules_of). Visibility: `static` = private, any other definition public (C has no finer access); a prototype at file level is exported (library mode: the header surface). A weak, section, interrupt, alias or naked function is a link-time or hardware entry (annotation.c-attribute); the entry points of a loader (DllMain, JNI_OnLoad, Java_*, PyInit_*, luaopen_*) are roots (main).
